scripts.preinstall: node -e "const [maj]=process.versions.node.split('.').map(Number); if (maj < 22) { console.error('\nNode ' + process.versions.node + ' is below this repo\'s floor of 22. Run: nvm use\n'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build: tsc -b && pnpm --filter @perfportal/api build && pnpm --filter @perfportal/worker build && pnpm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/worker/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/e2e/tsconfig.json
